fact: The public investment programme for 2026-2028, dated August 2025, lists under the Commissariat général de la Police the acquisition of an FCICAP criminal surveillance system for 22 provinces at a cost of CDF 5,800 million, with 3,800 million programmed for 2026 and 2,000 million for 2027.
title: Programme d’investissement public 2026-2028
publisher: Ministère du Plan et de la Coordination de l’Aide au Développement
